line_hint: Type a command, e.g. forward 100 · Enter adds a line
empty_canvas: Press Run to make the turtle draw.
help_text: ileri/forward N · geri/back N · sağ/right A · sol/left A · kalemkaldır/penup · kalemindir/pendown · renk/color red|#FF8800|random · kalınlık/width N · tekrarla/repeat N [ … ] · merkez/home · temizle/clear · yap/to NAME … son/end. Numbers can be expressions without spaces, e.g. repcount*3. Lines starting with ; are comments.
err_bracket_extra: there is a ] without a matching [
err_name: "{0}" is a command and cannot be a procedure name
err_nested_to: procedures cannot be defined inside procedures
err_long: the drawing is too long (more than 30000 steps)
